triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var player = battle.players.find(function(p) { return p.playerId === self.ownerId; }); if (!player) return false; var targetPiece = ctx.piece; if (!targetPiece || targetPiece.ownerPlayerId !== player.playerId) return false; var rawDamage = ctx.damage; if (!rawDamage || rawDamage <= 0) return false; var defense = targetPiece.defense || 0; var damageType = ctx.damageType; var effectiveDamage; if (damageType === 'true' || damageType === 'toxin') { effectiveDamage = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rawDamage)); } else { effectiveDamage = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rawDamage - defense)); } if (targetPiece.currentHp > effectiveDamage) return false; if (!player.statusTags) return false; return !!(player.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'elune-protection'; })); }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var player = battle.players.find(function(p) { return p.playerId === self.ownerId; }); if (!player) return { success: false }; var targetPiece = ctx.piece; if (!targetPiece) return { success: false }; var shieldTag = player.statusTags && player.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'elune-protection'; }); if (!shieldTag) return { success: false }; player.statusTags = player.statusTags.filter(function(t) { return t.type !== 'elune-protection'; }); self.expire(); targetPiece.currentHp = Math.min(targetPiece.currentHp + 5, targetPiece.maxHp); return { success: true, blocked: true, message: '艾露恩的守护：' + (targetPiece.name || targetPiece.templateId) + '免疫致命伤害并恢复5点生命（守护已消耗）' }; }
